visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown t-shirt and plaid shirt, speaks excitedly to the camera in a bright airport terminal. (2) A young man in a grey shirt and cap joins her, both smiling broadly at the camera. (3) The camera pans across a quiet airport terminal with empty check-in counters and overhead signage. (4) The woman holds up a smartphone showing a ride-hailing app interface with a map of Chiang Mai and pricing options. (5) A man in a blue shirt and jeans loads dark luggage into the back of a white SUV parked outside the terminal. (6) Interior view from the back seat of a car showing a small fan mounted on the dashboard and a navigation screen as it drives through rainy streets. (7) A close-up shows a finger pressing a biometric fingerprint scanner next to a wooden door. (8) The woman enters a modern apartment, reacting with wide-eyed excitement and covering her mouth with her hands. (9) A sequence of shots shows a kitchen with a metallic fridge and washer, a living room with large glass windows overlooking a city skyline and green mountains, and a small balcony. (10) The woman tests the furniture, sitting on a grey sofa, a wooden rocking chair, and finally a black desk in a dimly lit corner. (11) At night, the couple sits together on the sofa, looking relaxed and slightly tired, speaking softly to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female narration begins with an energetic tone over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track. (2) A sharp comic 'boing' SFX triggers as the scene shifts to the airport interior. (3) The female speaker’s pitch rises as she reacts to ride prices, accompanied by a male voice laughing in the background. (4) Sound of a heavy car trunk closing with a metallic thud follows the transition to the outdoors. (5) As they enter the room, the woman lets out a loud, high-frequency exclamation of joy, while the BGM continues steadily at 102 BPM. (6) A series of 'ding' SFX markers occur each time she tests a new piece of furniture. (7) Ambient room reverb is audible during the walkthrough. (8) The video concludes with softer vocal volume and a lower pitch as the couple relaxes on the sofa, ending with the sound of a soft thud as the man leans back.
